run_gmock_doctor: pipe compiler error messages into gmock_doctor.py via stdin to diagnose Google Mock usage problems
diagnose_gmock_errors: call Diagnose with a compiler error message string to get plain English diagnoses of Google Mock issues
review_diagnoser_functions: review the diagnoser functions like _NeedToReturnReferenceDiagnoser that pattern match GCC and Clang error messages
summarize_common_gmock_symbols: summarize the _COMMON_GMOCK_SYMBOLS list which catalogs matchers, actions, cardinalities, and sequences
refactor_generic_diagnoser: refactor _GenericDiagnoser to add new regex patterns and diagnosis messages for additional compiler error types
